author: diegosouzapw
body:
## Summary

This branch consolidates a full dashboard UX overhaul together with critical OAuth token refresh bug fixes targeted at `release/v3.8.0`.

### Dashboard & Navigation

- **Tabs → Pages**: converted all tab-based navigation into dedicated sidebar pages, eliminating nested tab UX
- **Collapsible sidebar**: 9 labelled sections (OmniProxy, Analytics, Monitoring, Dev Tools, Agentic Features, Other Features, Configuration, Help) with collapsible groups, pin behavior, and per-item tooltips; sidebar width narrowed to `w-[220px]`
- **MCP / A2A pages**: renamed to `*Server`, moved transport toggle and connection controls onto the respective pages, eliminated duplicated sidebar entries
- **API Manager**: renamed to "API Key Manager"; removed intro card, moved action button inline to Registered Keys header
- **Home page**: removed Providers Overview card

### Endpoint Page

- Accordion layout: active URL bar + collapsible rows per tunnel (Tailscale, ngrok)
- Streamlined expanded panels; inlined LAN IPs; fixed Tailscale detection and icon
- Grid layout for Available Endpoints card; added 4 missing endpoint entries
- Fixed React hydration error: outer `<button>` elements wrapping inner `<Button>` replaced with `<div role="button" tabIndex={0} onKeyDown>` (HTML spec violation caused app to fail to hydrate)

### Providers Page

- Custom section pinned to top; smaller cards; free tier section
- Provider summary card with free-test button; corrected dot colors per provider type
- Wider search field; fixed search icon alignment (uses Input's native `icon` prop instead of manual absolute positioning)
- Added **OpenCode Free** as a no-auth public provider

### Config / Dev

- Fixed `allowedDevOrigins`: replaced wildcard `"192.168.*"` (unsupported by Next.js) with exact IP `"192.168.0.250"` — app was stuck on "Loading…" when accessed from LAN

### OAuth Token Refresh (Critical Bug Fixes)

Root cause: expired OAuth tokens for Codex (7-day TTL) and Claude (1-hour TTL) were silently looping instead of being marked invalid, causing every subsequent request to retry with a permanently dead token.

**Five coordinated fixes across the refresh pipeline:**

1. **`open-sse/services/tokenRefresh.ts` — `refreshWithRetry`**: now checks `isUnrecoverableRefreshError()` on each attempt and bails immediately (no retries) when detected, returning the error object so callers can act on it
2. **`open-sse/services/tokenRefresh.ts` — `refreshClaudeOAuthToken`**: returns `{ error: "invalid_grant", code: "http_4xx" }` instead of `null` for expired refresh tokens, enabling unrecoverable detection in the retry loop
3. **`open-sse/executors/codex.ts` — `CodexExecutor.refreshCredentials`**: propagates the error object from `getAccessToken` instead of converting it to `null`, preserving the error type through the call chain
4. **`open-sse/handlers/chatCore.ts`**: imports `isUnrecoverableRefreshError`; on the reactive 401→refresh path, calls `onCredentialsRefreshed({ testStatus: "expired", isActive: false })` when the error is unrecoverable — connection is immediately marked invalid so it's excluded from future request routing
5. **`src/sse/handlers/chatHelpers.ts` + `src/sse/services/tokenRefresh.ts`**: `onCredentialsRefreshed` callback no longer hardcodes `testStatus: "active"`; forwards `isActive` flag; `updateProviderCredentials` handles `isActive !== undefined` correctly (boolean `false` was previously skipped by the `if` guard)

## Related Issues

- Closes #2297 (dashboard pages overhaul)
- Related to token refresh reliability

## Validation

- [x] `npm run lint`
- [x] `npm run test:unit`
- [x] `npm run test:coverage`
- [x] Coverage ≥ 75% statements/lines/functions, ≥ 70% branches (currently ~82%)

## Tests Added Or Updated

- `tests/unit/token-refresh-service.test.ts` — 4 new tests: `refreshWithRetry` bails on unrecoverable error (2 cases), `refreshClaudeOAuthToken` returns error object for `invalid_grant`, returns `null` for transient server errors
- `tests/unit/executor-codex.test.ts` — 1 new test: `CodexExecutor.refreshCredentials` propagates unrecoverable error object instead of returning null

## Coverage Notes

All new production code paths in `open-sse/` and `src/sse/` are covered by the tests above. No coverage regression.

## Reviewer Notes

- The OAuth fixes are the highest-risk area — they touch the refresh retry loop shared by all OAuth providers, not just Codex/Claude. The key invariant: `refreshWithRetry` now returns the raw error object (not `null`) when unrecoverable, so downstream callers that check `result?.accessToken` will correctly fall through to the error branch.
- The `chatHelpers.ts` change (`testStatus: newCreds.testStatus ?? "active"`) is backward-compatible: existing refresh success paths still produce `testStatus: "active"` via the `??` default; only the new expired-error path supplies a different value.
- Sidebar restructure touches `src/shared/constants/sidebarVisibility.ts` which is the single source of truth for all sidebar items — review section IDs and `HIDEABLE_SIDEBAR_ITEM_IDS` if adding new pages.

body:
## Submission Checklist

- [ X] My file is named `submissions/<github_username>.py`.
- [ X] My submission runs locally.
- [ X] My output matches the expected output.
- [X ] I did not hardcode the final output.

## Approach Description

First identify chains and build a DAG of chains.
Run 23 worker threads and 1 scheduler thread. Two queues work_queue (workers pull targets that are ready to build) and built_queue (scheduler pulls the output of a build and schedules a target is possible).

Each worker builds a chain in one go, then puts the output in the built queue. The scheduler is single threaded so no contention on processing the outputs of builds. It identifies any targets that are now ready and pushes requests to build with the target and inputs in the work_queue.

## Summary

Implements **Track 23 (Agentic Payments / x402)** end-to-end for the code phases — HTTP 402 micropayments as an **explicit, per-platform, default-OFF** capability. Also includes the rewritten `design.md` + new `tasks.md`.

> **Branch note:** per the chosen strategy this branch was derived from `feat/track-17-operational-diagnostics`, so this PR's diff also carries the unmerged Track 17 commits. The Track 23-specific changes are the two commits `docs(track-23): …` and `feat(track-23): …`.

### What's included (Phases 0–3)
- **`src/core/payments/x402/`** — `types`, `config` (Track 22 stand-in: in-track config gate, **OFF by default**), `tracker` (Track 18 stand-in: self-contained session ledger, wired into `Session.reset()`), `detect` + `limits` (ported from claudy; claudy's verified-broken hand-rolled EIP-712 deliberately **not** ported), `signer` (single `coinbase/x402` SDK seam — Phase-4 gated, fails safe), `PaymentKeyStore` (over the real `CredentialStore`), and the per-platform `capability`.
- **`ResourceFetchTool`** — the *only* payable surface (browserx has no fetch chokepoint; web tools are Chrome/CDP-driven and can't see HTTP status). Reached via a new `ToolContext.payments` handle populated by `ToolRegistry.setPaymentCapability`. Registered on all three platforms.

### Explicitly out of scope
- **Phase 4** is *not code* — mainnet enablement gated on key-custody + regulatory/legal review. Real signing throws a clear Phase-4 error; **no real funds can move**.
